Photo 1: close-up of the same unit's top/side, showing wiring harness connectors, bolts, and grime; a watermark reading 'NEMZ AUTOSPARE PARTS NIG' is visible on both images.
No part number, VIN tag, or manufacturer plate is legible in either photo.
No video or gauge/test-bench footage showing the unit running or shifting.

Conflicts with the earlier 'Japan highest grade' claim in the same text; neither origin is shown in the photos.

Cannot be assessed from static photos; requires audio/video of it running.

risks.if_unproven: priced as unconfirmed fitment, worst case generic unit

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or leaks obscured by dirt and oil residue on casing

Close-up photo of the part number/model tag on the casing

response.reason: The item is a used automatic gearbox identifiable by type, but all functional and origin claims are unverified or self-contradictory (Japan vs Belgium), so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, unconfirmed-fitment unit comparable to other generic foreign-used sedan/crossover gearboxes.
